items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: And I worked in a thing with Gary Cooper called The Legend Of The Condemned.

ctx.x: You mean playing in the pit.

Well, just playing on the side in the studio. For instance, the first movie I ever made was called A Road To Ruin, with Sally Allis(?) and I'm trying to think of the other actor's name. And I worked in a thing with Gary Cooper called The Legend Of The Condemned.
I've seen a movie from '29, '30 or someplace where there's no sound, but there's a picture of you and Mutt...
